episodeNumbering.compatibility: Historical evidence, handoffs, and result packs keep their recorded episode-catalog.v1 episode numbers. Apply this map only when presenting them beside the current roadmap; never rewrite their stored identity.

episodes.title: Warm-up
episodes.summary: Follow a request through prefill, decode and the KV cache. Explore the recorded vLLM and SGLang runs, their costs and the limits of the comparison.

episodes.title: Measurement and quality contracts
episodes.summary: Declare equal work, quality gates, latency SLOs, memory limits and budget before comparing configurations.
episodes.evidence: Local contract fixture — no provider measurement

episodes.title: Equal-work runtime baseline
episodes.summary: Compare HF/PyTorch, vLLM and SGLang under the same model, corpus, template and output contract.

episodes.title: Prefix reuse
episodes.summary: Control exact shared-prefix ratios and compare cold and warm cache behavior.

episodes.title: Batching, scheduling and mixed traffic
episodes.summary: Study chunked prefill and scheduler behavior under controlled long/short traffic mixes.

episodes.title: Attention kernels and precision
episodes.summary: Compare verified attention backends, then separately compare weight and KV precision.

episodes.title: Speculative decoding and structured outputs
episodes.summary: Evaluate compatible proposal paths and constrained generation without assuming speedup.
episodes.model: Target and optional draft — selected in planner

episodes.title: Parallelism within one node
episodes.summary: Compare DP, TP and justified PP or EP layouts under one declared GPU budget.

episodes.title: Parallelism across nodes
episodes.summary: Test placement and communication costs on a documented multi-node network topology.

episodes.title: Prefill/decode disaggregation and cache-aware routing
episodes.summary: Compare colocated and supported disaggregated serving with queue- and cache-aware routing.

episodes.title: Slurm and Kubernetes orchestration
episodes.summary: Compare representative scheduled jobs and long-running services as platform choices, separate from engines.

episodes.title: Model internals: weights to optimization
episodes.summary: Trace weights, attention, gradients and optimizer state with a small inspectable model.
episodes.model: Small inspectable model — selected in planner

episodes.title: LoRA and QLoRA with held-out evaluation
episodes.summary: Compare adapter training with fixed data, budgets and held-out quality evaluation.
episodes.model: Base and adapter lineage — selected in planner

episodes.title: Jev and LLMs on labeled decision tasks
episodes.summary: Compare typed and LLM decision approaches on one versioned labeled task contract.

episodes.title: Packaging, accelerator preflight and memory containment
episodes.summary: Verify reproducible containers, accelerator visibility, model loading and bounded memory behavior.

episodes.title: Saturation, SLO and cost
episodes.summary: Sweep concurrency and offered rate to find SLO-qualified goodput and attributable cost.

episodes.title: Release gates, recovery and capstone synthesis
episodes.summary: Combine promising settings, reject regressions and exercise rollback and recovery against original gates.
